narrative:
Good morning. Here is the Aktia snapshot as of this morning (FY2025 and Jan–Sep 2026 from published reports; plan data synthetic).

**Cost-to-income** — comparable CIR is 62.6% year-to-date and 66% in Q3, against a target below 60%. The 9+3 forecast is 63.2%; ROE is 12.7% but only 11.0% with normal credit losses (target > 12%).

**Income** — €217.4M year-to-date, €12.2M behind budget: NII −€7.5M on financing costs and hedges, life insurance −€2.7M. AUM is a record €18.2bn.

**Costs** — comparable opex €136.0M, €4.4M over budget (IT, personnel, purchased services, marketing).

**Credit** — a €3.5M net release instead of a €12.3M charge keeps operating profit near the €106M guidance.

**Pending your decision:** 4 items — the Oracle decommission date, the MOPS price-list change, the Q4 credit-loss charge and the 2027 AUM growth assumption.

signals.excerpt: Q3 comparable operating profit €22.5M (−18%); NII €31.9M (−6%) on higher financing costs; comparable opex €46.5M (+10%); credit losses €1.5M; net sales €124M.

signals.title: Path to CIR < 60%: +€11.3M income, −€6.5M cost
signals.excerpt: AUM +5%, Euribor +25 bp as hedges roll, MOPS price list +3%, Oracle decommission, purchased services, 15 open positions → CIR 58.7%, ROE 14.9% (13.3% with normal credit losses).

signals.title: Outlook 2026: comparable operating profit at or slightly above €106.0M
signals.excerpt: The positive effect of higher market rates on NII is expected to become visible next year.
